clues.text: A forward who scored the only goal of a Supercup win in Zenica.
He scored twice, once from the spot, as his team clinched a league title away in Posušje.
He opened the scoring in a 5–0 league-phase win over a Gibraltar side.
He first joined the club in February 2016 as a forward.
A forward with several separate spells at the club.
His career total for the club is 75 league goals.
He is the club's all-time leading scorer.
He played in 188 matches for the club.
